source_layout: 10 contiguous 900-sample sensor blocks per exposure row; 30 source time bins of 30 seconds x 10 original sensor channels
normalization: Each original source channel's 30-second bin mean divided by the same original exposure's initial 300-second baseline mean minus 1
holdout_policy: whole original concentration level excluded (50/100/200), 60 source exposures train, 30 source exposures test in each fold; all 30 bins from each source exposure kept together

fixed_training_settings.encoder: frozen source architecture; only logistic head trained
fixed_training_settings.multiclass: one-versus-rest for six original source gas classes, choose maximum uncalibrated score

gnn_omission: No source-established UCI sensor graph topology/adjoining edges; cannot invent graph and call it physically validated.
limitations: No source-proof of independent devices, days, or physically separate Tank sensor boards.
Frozen encoder architecture parameters mean NONE of the four methods is an end-to-end trained neural CNN/TCN/GRU/GNN.

Higher source GRU mean balanced accuracy 0.811111 compared to earlier V6 Java Softmax source 0.766667 is not a controlled superiority result because feature representation differs and no independent device/day experiment exists.
The source concentration unit ppb identifies sample labels only; no inferred HazRob Tank gas concentration in ppm is verified.
All results exploratory source model discrimination only; 0/80 Tank G3, no safety identification or unknown-gas rejection certification, no application UI integration or APK.
First 300 seconds are the UCI per-exposure baseline context, not a startup heating physics model. First-minute MQ/Bosch transient development remains deferred.
